units.title: 动物园喂食讲解的等候安排

materials.title: Zoo Feeding Talk Rules 037A
materials.text: At the zoo, only keepers feed the animals. Visitors wait behind the low barrier. The talk starts after the keeper brings the food box. Keep snacks in your own bag. If you cannot see, ask the helper for the children’s viewing place. Leave the gate closed.

questions.prompt: A friend takes out food for an animal. Say: ____
options: Only the keeper feeds the animals here.
questions.explanation: A直接纠游客喂食；B厕所、C换零食不授权给动物食物。

questions.prompt: Your friend steps over the low barrier. Say: ____
questions.explanation: C退到栏后对应边界；A拍照、B问时间不纠越栏。

questions.prompt: The keeper has not brought the food box. A friend asks if the talk starts now. Say: ____
options: We wait until the keeper brings the box.
The viewing place is for children.
Our snacks stay in our bags.
questions.explanation: A食箱到后开始，答时机；B观景处、C零食是别规则不答开讲。

questions.prompt: A small child cannot see. Say: ____
options: Ask the helper for the children’s viewing place.
Put your snacks away and say nothing.
questions.explanation: B提供的儿童观景位求助；A越门违边界；C收食不改善视线。

questions.prompt: A friend starts opening the animal gate. Say: ____
questions.explanation: C门保持关直接回应；A问题、B放包不允许开门。

units.title: 修鞋柜台前说清楚问题

materials.title: Shoe Repair Counter Needs 037A
materials.text: A child visits the shoe-repair counter with a parent. Choose the sentence that matches each need.

questions.prompt: A strap on your shoe is loose. You need to show the problem. Say: ____
options: What time does the shop close?
May I have a paper bag?
This strap is loose. Could you check it?
questions.explanation: C指出松带请求检查；A关门时、B纸袋不说明修补问题。

questions.prompt: You need to know when the repaired pair will be ready. Ask: ____
options: When will this pair be ready?
Can I keep the old laces?
questions.explanation: B问修好时间；A付款点、C保鞋带不问进度。

questions.prompt: The helper asks whether to replace your laces. You want to keep them. Say: ____
options: What colour is the new sole?
Please keep these laces if they are still usable.
questions.explanation: B明确保留仍可用鞋带；A新底颜色、C收据不回答替换意愿。

questions.prompt: You need the price before choosing the repair. Ask: ____
options: How much will this repair cost?
questions.explanation: A先核维修价支持决定；B成品架、C号卡位置不告费用。

questions.prompt: The returned shoes look similar to yours. You want the number checked. Ask: ____
options: May I try a different colour?
Could you show me the opening hours?
Could you check that the number matches our card?
questions.explanation: C核物与取件卡同号；A颜色、B开门时不确认物主。

units.title: 春日整理活动的十段完整句子

materials.title: Spring Cleanup Ten Choices 037A
materials.text: Choose the word or reply fitting each complete spring-cleanup situation.

questions.prompt: Our two helpers ____ collecting empty boxes now.
questions.explanation: B two helpers复数are；A is单数、C am配I不合。

questions.prompt: The gloves belong to us. They are ____ gloves.
questions.explanation: C belong to us对应our；A她、B他非共同物主。

questions.prompt: Please ____ the books on the clean shelf, not on the wet floor.
questions.explanation: A祈使put原形；B单三、C分词不构成该指令。

questions.prompt: The box is heavy. I ____ help to lift it with an adult.
questions.explanation: A I现在谓语need；B单三不配I；C分词缺be。

questions.prompt: The clean cloth is for the table. Use ____ gently on the surface.
questions.explanation: B use后宾格it指布；A物主需名词，C反身本句无主宾同一。

questions.prompt: There are three ____ for the three work areas.
questions.explanation: C three要求baskets标准复数；A单数，B拼错。

questions.prompt: ____ can check the repair box? The caretaker.
questions.explanation: C caretaker答人物Who；A时间、B地点不对应。

questions.prompt: The wet coats need air. We hang them up to get ____.
questions.explanation: A dry对应wet挂晾目的；B饿、C吵不描述衣物去湿。

questions.prompt: Does this toy still work? Yes, it ____.
questions.explanation: C Does问用does答；A are不配it且非work助动词，B do不配单三it。

questions.prompt: The shelves are ready. Let us ____ the labels next.
questions.explanation: B let us后make原形；A单三、C分词不合。

units.title: 校园活动核对时的五个回答

materials.title: School Fair Checking Replies 037A
materials.text:
Match each question to its best reply. Use every reply once.
A. Because the small hall is being cleaned.
B. At the desk inside the garden entrance.
C. After all the cards have been checked.
D. The teacher wearing the visitor badge.
E. Yes, if you keep it in its cover.

questions.prompt: Who can confirm which room our group has booked?
options: Because the small hall is being cleaned.
At the desk inside the garden entrance.
After all the cards have been checked.
The teacher wearing the visitor badge.
Yes, if you keep it in its cover.
questions.explanation: D访客牌教师答核预订人员；A清洁原因、B桌位、C核卡后时机、E套内借用条件不答Who。

questions.prompt: When may we enter as a group?
options: Because the small hall is being cleaned.
At the desk inside the garden entrance.
After all the cards have been checked.
The teacher wearing the visitor badge.
Yes, if you keep it in its cover.
questions.explanation: C全部卡核后答进场时机；A原因、B桌位、D人、E借用条件不答When。

questions.prompt: Why are we waiting outside the small hall?
options: Because the small hall is being cleaned.
At the desk inside the garden entrance.
After all the cards have been checked.
The teacher wearing the visitor badge.
Yes, if you keep it in its cover.
questions.explanation: A小厅清洁解释暂等；B桌位、C核卡后时间、D人、E套内许可不答清洁原因。

questions.prompt: May I borrow this picture board?
options: Because the small hall is being cleaned.
At the desk inside the garden entrance.
After all the cards have been checked.
The teacher wearing the visitor badge.
Yes, if you keep it in its cover.
questions.explanation: E可以但保持护套，答借物条件；A原因、B桌位、C核卡时机、D人不答该许可。

questions.prompt: Where do we collect the activity cards?
options: Because the small hall is being cleaned.
At the desk inside the garden entrance.
After all the cards have been checked.
The teacher wearing the visitor badge.
Yes, if you keep it in its cover.
questions.explanation: B花园入口内桌答领取点；A原因、C时机、D人、E借板条件不答Where。

units.title: 花园路线里的五种物体

materials.title: Garden Route Noun Bank 037A
materials.text:
Read the complete route and choose each shared noun once. Bank: A. bench B. gate C. path D. bridge E. pond
We enter the garden through a wooden ____1____ set in the fence. To cross the narrow stream, we use a small ____2____. Nearby, ducks swim in a still round ____3____, separate from the flowing stream. At our rest stop, three pupils can sit on a long ____4____. Then we follow the marked walking ____5____ until it meets the road.

questions.prompt: Which noun completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: B gate是围栏开口可进门；A bench坐具、C path小路、D bridge过水桥、E pond池塘均非围栏门。

questions.prompt: Which noun completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: D bridge跨小溪；A长凳、B门、C路本身不提供所述跨溪结构，E池是水体非跨越设施。

questions.prompt: Which noun completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: E pond是独立静水池可有鸭；A长凳、B门、C路、D桥均非静止水体。

questions.prompt: Which noun completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A bench长坐具可三人休息；B gate门、C path路、D bridge桥、E pond池不作该长椅。

questions.prompt: Which noun completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: C walking path为标记步行路线；A bench坐具、B gate门口、D bridge局部桥、E pond水体均不是延伸接路的小径。

units.title: 报名花园小帮手的完整对话

materials.title: Garden Helper Complete Dialogue 037A
materials.text:
Complete the whole conversation using each bank reply once.
A. I would like to help with planting.
B. Yes, please. Mum will collect me.
C. Beside the greenhouse.
D. After class on Friday.
E. A small trowel and gloves.

Teacher: What job would you like to do?
Pupil: ____1____
Teacher: Which tools shall we set out for your job?
Pupil: ____2____
Teacher: When can you come to help?
Pupil: ____3____
Teacher: Where shall the group meet?
Pupil: ____4____
Teacher: May I ask your parent about the collection time?
Pupil: ____5____

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 1?
options: I would like to help with planting.
Yes, please. Mum will collect me.
questions.explanation: A种植工作答What job；B家长联系许可、C地点、D时间、E工具均不说明工作意愿。

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 2?
options: I would like to help with planting.
Yes, please. Mum will collect me.
questions.explanation: E小铲和手套答工具；A工作、B许可、C地点、D时间不列工具。

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 3?
options: I would like to help with planting.
Yes, please. Mum will collect me.
questions.explanation: D周五课后答When；A工作、B许可、C地点、E工具不答到来时机。

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 4?
options: I would like to help with planting.
Yes, please. Mum will collect me.
questions.explanation: C温室旁答Where；A工作、B许可、D时间、E工具不答集合地点。

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 5?
options: I would like to help with planting.
Yes, please. Mum will collect me.
questions.explanation: B Yes许可联系家长并说明接送者；A工作、C地点、D一般帮忙时间、E工具均不回应联系许可。

units.title: 望远镜里为什么先是一片黑

materials.title: Binoculars Caps Eight Cloze 037A
materials.text:
Read the whole story and choose the best word for every gap.
On the bird walk, my view through the binoculars was completely ____1____. I thought the instrument was broken. The helper noticed that the lens ____2____ were still on. Once removed, light came through, but the view was ____3____ blurred for me. The helper adjusted the ____4____ while I looked at the same distant tree. People’s settings could be ____5____, so copying my friend’s setting was not enough. I handled the binoculars ____6____ and kept the covers together. Before I had to ____7____ them, I ____8____ that both covers and the strap were present.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: C lens caps在故视野黑dark；A饿、B木制非视野亮度状态。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: A lens caps镜盖遮光；B食谱、C票非镜头外盖。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: B still说明去盖后仍模糊；A下方、C昨天不表持续未解决状态。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A调focus焦点改善模糊；B天气、C价格不改变观看清晰度。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: C不同人设置different，不能只照朋友；A睡、B圆非设置相异关系。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C gently轻拿照护借物；A方、B渴不表处理方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 7?
questions.explanation: B借物最终return归还；A尝、C种非保管结束动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 8?
questions.explanation: A checked盖带齐全作归还前核对；B煮、C睡不验证配件。

units.title: 请带一盘东西的邀请

materials.title: Bring A Plate Story 037A
materials.text: My aunt’s invitation said, "Please bring a plate." I arrived carrying an empty plate from our cupboard. Aunt smiled and explained what she meant for this party: each family could bring some food to share. She had not wanted more empty dishes. She still welcomed me and offered food from the table. We found a use for my plate by putting fruit on it. Before the next gathering, I asked what food would be useful rather than guessing. Aunt also wrote "a plate of food to share" on her next invitation so new guests would understand her meaning.

questions.prompt: The writer understands the intended food-sharing meaning immediately.
questions.explanation: B正确：初带空盘，后姑姨解释才知；A把后理解提前。

questions.prompt: The writer first arrives with an empty plate.
questions.explanation: A正确：empty plate fromcupboard；B否认起始实物。

questions.prompt: Aunt explains what she means for this particular party.
questions.explanation: A正确：what she meant forthisparty食物共享；B否认文中解释。

questions.prompt: Aunt sends the writer home without sharing any food.
questions.explanation: B正确：仍欢迎且供桌上食物；A把误会变成驱逐无据。

questions.prompt: The next invitation uses more explicit wording about food.
questions.explanation: A正确：plate of food to share更清楚；B否认后续改写。

units.title: 出游与舞台记录的词形

materials.title: Outing Stage Record Forms 037A
materials.text:
Complete every gap using the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Last Saturday, we ____1____ (stand) at the meeting point for ten minutes.
2. Three ____2____ (goose) crossed the grass near the pond.
3. The information desk is ____3____ (busy) than the quiet book corner.
4. Look! The runner is ____4____ (run) along the marked track.
5. We spoke ____5____ (quiet; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly) while the actors waited behind the curtain.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use STAND.
questions.explanation: 接受stood：Last Saturday过去，stand不规则；stand原形、standed错、standing分词非过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use GOOSE.
questions.explanation: 接受geese：Three明确动物名词复数，goose不规则；goose单数、gooses本句名词复数不合、geeses重复复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use BUSY.
questions.explanation: 接受busier：than比较繁忙程度，busy变busier；busy原级、busiest最高级、busyness名词不作比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use RUN.
questions.explanation: 接受running：is进行，run双写n；run原形、runing错拼、ran过去式不合正在跑。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from QUIET.
questions.explanation: 接受quietly：本空明确QUIET常规-ly副词。quiet、quieter、quietness不满足本空形态约束；不据此断言其他语境合法性，未列复核。

units.title: 担任小主持时的五个确认

materials.title: Young Host Functions 037A
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves the young host’s stated purpose. Other options are event questions with different goals.

questions.prompt: Before introducing a guest, you need the guest’s preferred pronunciation of their name. What should you ask?
options: How would you like me to pronounce your name in the introduction?
questions.explanation: C询本人希望的姓名读法以准确介绍；A座位、B时长不提供读音。

questions.prompt: Your microphone fails and you need a working replacement. What should you say?
options: Could we use the backup microphone for this announcement?
Who will speak after the break?
questions.explanation: A请求备用麦克风解决故障；B顺序、C节目册不提供扩声替代。

questions.prompt: Two programme sheets show different next speakers. You need the stage manager’s confirmation. What should you ask?
options: Could I have a larger print copy?
Which speaker is confirmed next on the current programme?
questions.explanation: B核当前下一位讲者；A字大、C观众排队不辨内容版本。

questions.prompt: A guest has one minute left, and you want a polite reminder to finish. What should you say?
options: May I ask about your favourite book?
We have one minute remaining. Could you give your final point, please?
Would you like to choose a different chair?
questions.explanation: B说明剩时并请求末要点；A新问题可能延长，C椅子不提示收尾。

questions.prompt: You want to thank the team for specific work at the end. What should you say?
options: Thank you for setting up the sound and helping every guest find a seat.
questions.explanation: C具体感谢音响和引座贡献；A闭馆、B多印海报不是致谢。

units.title: 天气板上的现在与稍后

materials.title: Weather Board Now Later 037B
materials.text: Our class weather board has two parts. "Now" says a garden walk. "Later" says crafts inside. The teacher may change the later plan when the weather changes. Read the newest message before leaving. Only the teacher changes the board. Ask if a message is unclear.

questions.prompt: A friend reads the Later part and says it is craft time now. Say: ____
options: We can change the board ourselves.
Now says the garden walk; crafts are later.
The oldest note is always right.
questions.explanation: B区分Now与Later的活动，直接纠时间状态；A无权改，C旧注非依据。

questions.prompt: The weather changes, and a friend wants to follow an old note. Say: ____
options: Check the newest message before we leave.
Put the craft box by the door.
questions.explanation: B天气可能改后计划，应核最新消息；A沿旧、C挪箱不确定当前安排。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to rewrite the board. Say: ____
options: Only the teacher changes this board.
questions.explanation: C改板者为教师；A任写违权责，B问鞋不说明改板权限。

questions.prompt: You cannot understand the new message. Ask: ____
options: Could you explain this message, please?
questions.explanation: A求解释所读不明消息；B午餐盒、C借笔不澄清内容。

questions.prompt: A friend says the Later plan can never change. Say: ____
options: The board has only one part.
The garden walk is never now.
The teacher may change it when the weather changes.
questions.explanation: C明确Later可因天气由教师改；A两部分已给，B：Now实际花园，均不实。

units.title: 家庭骑行计划的五个回答

materials.title: Family Cycle Plan Matching 037B
materials.text:
Match the family’s questions with the best replies. Use each reply once.
A. After Dad checks our bikes.
B. Because it is too busy with cars.
C. In the side pocket of your bag.
D. Yes, we can stop at the bench.
E. The flat path beside the river.

questions.prompt: Where should I keep my water bottle?
options: Because it is too busy with cars.
In the side pocket of your bag.
Yes, we can stop at the bench.
The flat path beside the river.
questions.explanation: C包侧袋答水瓶存处；A出发时、B避路原因、D休息许可、E路线不答所问物品位置。

questions.prompt: My legs are tired. May we have a rest?
options: Because it is too busy with cars.
In the side pocket of your bag.
Yes, we can stop at the bench.
The flat path beside the river.
questions.explanation: D可在长椅停答休息请求；A检查后出发、B原因、C袋位、E路线不回应可否休息。

questions.prompt: When can we start our ride?
options: Because it is too busy with cars.
In the side pocket of your bag.
Yes, we can stop at the bench.
The flat path beside the river.
questions.explanation: A父亲检查车后答开始条件；B避路因、C物位、D休息许可、E路线不答When。

questions.prompt: Which route shall we take?
options: Because it is too busy with cars.
In the side pocket of your bag.
Yes, we can stop at the bench.
The flat path beside the river.
questions.explanation: E河旁平路答路线选择；A时间、B原因、C瓶位、D休息许可不列路线。

questions.prompt: Why are we avoiding the main road?
options: Because it is too busy with cars.
In the side pocket of your bag.
Yes, we can stop at the bench.
The flat path beside the river.
questions.explanation: B汽车多说明避路原因；A检查时机、C袋位、D休息、E所选路名并非该道路原因。

units.title: 野餐准备里的十段完整句子

materials.title: Picnic Preparation Ten Choices 037B
materials.text: Choose the word or reply that fits each complete picnic-preparation situation.

questions.prompt: Mina and I are ready. ____ have packed the mats together.
questions.explanation: C Mina和说话者为We；A He、B It单数不合两人共同动作。

questions.prompt: Mum is holding the food box. Please help ____.
questions.explanation: B help后宾格her指Mum；A主格、C物主不作该人物宾语。

questions.prompt: The sun is hot, so we choose a place with ____.
questions.explanation: A shade阴凉回应热日；B噪声、C泥不解决太阳热的需求。

questions.explanation: C must not加open表达午前禁开；A/B be后不直接接open形成此谓语。

questions.explanation: B water不可数用is；A复数are、C I配am不合。

questions.prompt: These sandwiches are for Dad. They are ____ lunch.
questions.explanation: B Dad物主his；A她、C我们不符已给对象。

questions.prompt: Please ____ the fruit before putting it on the clean plate.
questions.explanation: C祈使wash原形；A单三、B分词不成指令。

questions.prompt: There are two empty ____ for the apples.

questions.prompt: Would you like to carry the small mat? Yes, ____.
questions.explanation: C接受搬小垫任务并表能做；A天气、B地点不回应任务邀请。

units.title: 野餐小帮手的完整对话

Yes, but keep the name card with them.
Because the other table is wet.

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 3?

Yes, but keep the name card with them.
Because the other table is wet.
questions.explanation: A洗手后答进食条件；B用品、C许可、D位置、E桌因不答When。

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 4?
options: My water bottle and a mat.
Yes, but keep the name card with them.
Because the other table is wet.
questions.explanation: E另一桌湿解释用此桌；A时机、B用品、C许可、D位置均不答Why。

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 5?
options: My water bottle and a mat.
Yes, but keep the name card with them.
Because the other table is wet.
questions.explanation: C可共夹但保姓名卡，答作品归档许可；A吃前时、B用品、D食物盒、E桌因不答该许可。

units.title: 纸张测试里的五个动作词

materials.title: Paper Test Verb Bank 037B
materials.text:
Read the complete passage and choose each shared verb once. Bank: A. return B. compare C. explain D. borrow E. choose
We cannot do the paper test without clips, so we ____1____ a small set from the desk. We then ____2____ two kinds of paper using the same steps. After recording the results, we ____3____ the stronger paper for our model. We ____4____ our choice to visitors instead of just pointing at it. At the end, we ____5____ the borrowed clips to the desk.

questions.prompt: Which verb completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: D borrow从台借工具满足先缺夹；A return尚未借不能还，B compare后缺对比关系，C explain不取工具，E choose不表达借用关系。

questions.prompt: Which verb completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B compare同样步骤比两纸；A return归还、C explain说明、D borrow借、E choose选均不直接表示进行双材料对照。

questions.prompt: Which verb completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: E choose据结果选强纸；A return归还、B compare此处已比完、C explain后是解释而非选用、D borrow借纸不表选择结果。

questions.prompt: Which verb completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: C explain choice to visitors说明选择；A return、B compare、D borrow、E choose不合解释给访客的结构目的。

questions.prompt: Which verb completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: A return borrowed clips结束归还；B compare、C explain、D borrow、E choose均不完成借还收尾。

units.title: 擦字、看电影与骑行的五个词

materials.title: Daily Need Word Categories 037B
materials.text: Choose the word that meets the exact description or everyday need.

questions.prompt: A child wants to remove pencil marks from paper. Which tool is meant for this?
questions.explanation: C eraser擦铅笔痕；A刷画、B测长不执行擦除。

questions.prompt: Which place is built mainly for showing films to an audience?
questions.explanation: A cinema电影院主要放映电影；B厨房做饭，C操场运动不具此主要用途。

questions.prompt: Drops of rain are falling from the sky. Which weather word matches?
questions.explanation: C rainy直接描述下雨；A sunny不表雨落，B无风不对应所见降雨信息。

questions.prompt: A child yawns after a long afternoon and wants a rest. Which feeling is most directly shown?
questions.explanation: B tired由哈欠和需休息支持；A渴需饮水线索，C怒无情绪证据。

questions.prompt: Which vehicle usually has two wheels and is moved by the rider’s pedals?
questions.explanation: A bicycle自行车脚踏两轮；B公交、C火车不符合此结构驱动。

units.title: 花盆挡住了价目牌的一部分

materials.title: Covered Price Board Six Cloze 037B
materials.text:
Read the complete story and choose a word for each numbered gap.
At the school market, a flowerpot ____1____ the top of a price board. We could see only ____2____ of the message, including "two yuan" near the bottom. I thought every book cost that amount. Before paying, I ____3____ the seller to confirm. She ____4____ the pot and showed the whole board. Bookmarks were two yuan, but books had a ____5____ price. She placed the plant on another shelf so future customers could see the ____6____ information. We bought the items we actually wanted after reading all the lines.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A covered挡顶导致只见部分；B唱、C借不描述花盆遮牌。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: C part与only及后文whole对照；A全部、B全无均与能见部分文字矛盾。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: B asked seller confirm付款前询；A睡、C煮不核价格。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: B moved pot露全牌；A数盆、C尝盆不揭被挡文字。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: A books与bookmark不同价；B睡、C木制不表价差。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C complete完整牌对照先part；A饿、B圆不描述信息完备。

units.title: 篮子提手上的纸鸟邀请

materials.title: Paper Bird Invitation Story 037B
materials.text:
Milo borrowed a basket from his neighbour to carry pears home from the market. When he returned it, she tied a small paper bird to the handle and asked him to keep the basket until Saturday. Milo thought the bird was only decoration. Then he noticed writing along one wing.
The message invited his family to the neighbour’s orchard picnic at three on Saturday and asked them to bring their own cups. The basket would be useful for carrying fruit back afterwards. Milo carefully opened the wing enough to read every word, then folded it back without hiding the time. At home, he put the paper bird on the kitchen windowsill and the cups beside the basket. His mother read the invitation while making tea.

questions.prompt: Why does Milo first borrow the basket?
options: To collect books from a class.
To carry pears from the market.
questions.explanation: D开头为搬市场梨；A校服、B火车模型、C课本均非所述。

questions.prompt: What does Milo initially think the paper bird is?
options: A price label for the basket.
A note saying the basket is broken.
questions.explanation: B initiallyonly decoration；A价签、C收据、D破篮说明无据。

questions.prompt: What does the writing invite his family to do?
options: Join an orchard picnic on Saturday.
questions.explanation: B周六果园野餐；A周五归杯、C修窗、D校内买篮都非邀请。

questions.prompt: Why may Milo keep the basket until Saturday?
options: It belongs to him permanently now.
It can carry fruit home after the picnic.
It must be used as a seat.
questions.explanation: C野餐后带水果用途；A永久赠、B忘、D座位均未提。

questions.prompt: What does Milo do after reading?
options: Keep the invitation visible and prepare cups beside the basket.
Throw away the bird as wrapping.
Hide the time from his family.
Leave all cups at the market.
questions.explanation: A窗台纸鸟不遮时间且杯置篮旁；B丢鸟、C藏时、D市场留杯都与结尾相反。

units.title: 聚会与排练记录的词形

materials.title: Meeting Note Word Forms 037B
materials.text:
Complete every gap using the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Yesterday, the coach ____1____ (tell) us when the rehearsal would begin.
2. Three ____2____ (neighbour) received invitations to the community picnic.
3. The new marked route is ____3____ (safe) than the steep old path.
4. Look! The children are ____4____ (clap) along with the short song.
5. The teacher explained the change ____5____ (clear; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly).

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use TELL.
questions.explanation: 接受told：Yesterday过去，tell不规则；tell原形、telled错、telling分词非过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use NEIGHBOUR.
questions.explanation: 接受neighbours英式或neighbors美式标准复数；Three排除单数neighbour，neighbour’s所有格和neighbourses重复复数不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use SAFE.
questions.explanation: 接受safer：is和than明确形容词比较；safe原级、safest最高级、safety名词不作该比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use CLAP.
questions.explanation: 接受clapping：are进行，clap双写p；clap原形、claping错拼、clapped过去式不合正在拍。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from CLEAR.
questions.explanation: 接受clearly：本空明确CLEAR常规-ly副词。clear、clearer、clearness不满足本空任务形式；不据此断言一般英语中的其他用法不合法，未列复核。

units.title: 线上社团里如何请求所需支持

materials.title: Online Club Functions 037B
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves each participant’s stated purpose. Other choices are plausible meeting requests with different goals.

questions.prompt: You join late and need a summary of decisions already made. What should you say?
options: Could we move next week’s meeting?
Could someone briefly recap the decisions made before I joined?
Which software did we use last year?
questions.explanation: B简要重述已定事项补迟入信息；A改下周、C去年软件不补当前决策。

questions.prompt: Background noise from an open microphone makes listening difficult. What should you ask?
options: Could I share a different slide?
Could that microphone be muted while the person is not speaking?
questions.explanation: C非发言时静音直接减背景声；A换幻灯、B出勤表不降当前噪声。

questions.prompt: Your connection dropped during one instruction. You want that step written in the chat. What should you say?
options: May I change my display colour?
Could you type the instruction I missed into the chat?
questions.explanation: C请求缺漏步骤文字补充；A邀请、B颜色不恢复指令。

questions.prompt: You can join by voice but cannot use a camera today. You need permission for that format. What should you ask?
options: May I take part by voice without the camera today?
Could we print all the meeting notes?
When will the next speaker finish?
questions.explanation: A明确无摄像头语音参与许可；B印记、C讲者结束时不答参与形式。

questions.prompt: An old recording link does not open, and you need the current approved link. What should you ask?
options: Where can I find the current recording link approved for this class?
Could we change the meeting topic?
questions.explanation: A询当前已准本课录制链接；B主题、C图片作者不解决正确访问链接。
